name: siriusly
description: Turn real estate listings into property videos: silent tours, narrated tours and guided walkthroughs with an AI presenter.

interface.longDescription: siriusly helps real estate agents and agencies turn a property listing into a marketing video. Share a listing link, or upload the photos and a description, and siriusly reads the photos, price and key facts. Pick the kind of video: a silent tour where the listing photos come alive, a narrated tour with a voiceover, a guided walkthrough with an AI presenter on camera, or a presenter in the corner talking over the tour. Choose a presenter and a script, check the details before the video is made, and get a video ready for the listing page and social media.
defaultPrompt: Make a property video from my listing link
Turn these listing photos into a silent tour video
What would a 60 second narrated tour cost?

positive.description: Read a listing and start the video flow
positive.prompt: Make a property video from this listing: <public property listing link>
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the siriusly card with the listing photos, facts and a choice of video type.

positive.description: Price a video before making it
positive.prompt: What would a 30 second silent tour of this listing cost? <public property listing link>
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the credit cost and the user's available credits; nothing is charged.

positive.description: Create a silent tour after confirming the cost
positive.prompt: Make a 20 second silent tour of this listing. <public property listing link>
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the cost, starts the video only after the user confirms, and the card shows its progress.
Shows the latest video's status, or the finished video with Open and Download.

positive.description: Upload photos when there is no listing link
positive.prompt: I don't have a listing link, I want to upload the photos.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows an upload form for the property photos and a description.

negative.prompt: Write me a poem about the sea.
Show me the videos my colleague made in their siriusly account.
